purpose: Machine-checked inventory of every non-test outbound Canvas-mutation-shaped call under api/. Keyed by repo-relative path + qualified enclosing symbol + detector + call_index, never by line number. This file is the machine authority for docs/reference/mutation-reconciliation-map.md and for api/tests/test_canvas_mutation_ownership.py.

detector_legend.attr:<name>: an attribute call, e.g. requests.post(...) or canvas_client._canvas_send(...); <name> is the attribute (post/put/patch/delete/request/_canvas_send/canvas_send).
detector_legend.name:<name>: a bare-name call to an injected/imported callable literally named canvas_send or _canvas_send (dependency-injection parameter or direct import), not accessed via attribute.
detector_legend.alias:<verb>: a mutation-verb HTTP function referenced via assignment aliasing (e.g. http_post = requests.post) rather than called directly at that site.

call_index_note: 1-based occurrence index of the same (path, symbol, detector) triple, in source order. Distinguishes multiple calls of the same kind inside one enclosing symbol without using line numbers.

The Seating group-set ledger adapter uses this create-only transport after review and checkpoints the returned category ID. Its exact-category reconciliation invokes roster.py's _reconcile_group_category, which targeted-merges the private groups mirror and falls back to invalidation without changing the confirmed write result.

Callers (roster.py, roster_groups.py) invoke _reconcile_group_category after a verified write, which live-refetches only the affected category and merges it via mirror_store.merge_group_category, falling back to whole-document invalidate_groups only on failure.

Roster callers and the create-only Seating group-set ledger adapter use this returned-membership transport. The ledger reconciles only its checkpointed new category through _reconcile_group_category; existing categories and memberships are never changed by that adapter.
Same _reconcile_group_category convergence path as create_canvas_group.
Route calls the injected invalidate_groups callback (roster.py's _reconcile_group_category) after a verified create, same targeted-merge-with-invalidate-fallback path as roster_canvas.py.

Scheduled-routine late sweep; same as SweepAdapter.execute. Writes seconds_late_override, which no mirror consumer reads; late-work identification is recomputed inside CanvasExpert from timestamps (work_registry/providers/late_work.py). No submissions-projection reconciliation is owed. Not a Former Program 9 gap.

Scheduled-routine curve writer. Its caller _run_routine_curve fires one coalesced mirror_service.notify_course_changed(course_id) after each course's whole curve batch (once per course that curved at least one assignment), which runs sync.refresh_submissions_course_delta — the same narrow per-course submissions delta refresh PowerGrader and the direct curve routes use. Fire-and-forget; the heartbeat repairs any miss.

Reconciled on every entry point. The three api/webui/routes/powergrader.py callers of the wrapper run_interactive_autopush call _notify_write_through -> mirror_service.notify_course_changed -> sync.refresh_submissions_course_delta on success. The direct scheduled-autoscore caller api/webui/routes/routines_powergrader.py (which calls run_autopush_for_session, bypassing the wrapper) reconciles inline via mirror_service.notify_course_changed guarded on pushed. Both are the same narrow per-course submissions delta refresh.
The /api/powergrader/session/{id}/push route calls _notify_write_through -> mirror_service.notify_course_changed -> sync.refresh_submissions_course_delta after a verified push.

The specialized native New Quiz item-score/feedback transport (spine 11.x). api/webui/routes/powergrader.py's _converge_new_quiz_after_finalize calls both new_quizzes.invalidate_responses (whole-scope stale-mark on new_quiz.responses) and _notify_write_through (targeted per-course submissions delta refresh on private.submissions) after a verified finalize. Recorded as 'targeted' for the dominant/most-complete convergence leg; the new_quiz.responses leg is an 'invalidate', not a precise merge.
